The authored-toy package now has two independent gauge-route constructors, separate fresh spawned schedule processes, an explicit bridge, oriented D4 covariance, five ordered real-coefficient model classes, locality shells, four discriminating adverse controls, a closed schema, and an independent verifier. The human response `recommendation authorized` resolves RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-C-ACCEPTED-PARENT-DESIGN-HC11 and authorizes accepted-parent Stage C design only. The proposed design binds exact accepted parent and prerequisite identities, separates isotropic D4, anisotropic D2, and distinct-parent axis-swap controls, freezes 208 route evaluations, 104 bridges, 1,040 model fits, 104 schedule comparisons, ten adverse controls, independent verification, compact retention, and a 600-second/2-GiB/20-MiB local envelope. The authored behavior retains 208 route evaluations, 104 bridges, 1,040 model fits, 104 schedule comparisons, and ten adverse controls; all criteria and both anisotropic adverse floors pass. Independent reconstruction reports a maximum scalar difference 1.922e-15 E_G. A measured run completed in 1.56 seconds with 99,041,280 bytes maximum resident set size and a 2,205,921-byte result. The verbatim human response `1` resolves RM-IMPURITY-DEFECT-2D-STAGE-C-ACCEPTED-PARENT-IMPLEMENTATION-ACCEPTANCE-HC14 to ACCEPT_EXECUTION_FREE_PARENT_STAGE_C_AND_AUTHORIZE_MANAGED_CLOSEOUT, human-accepts this exact execution-free implementation boundary, and authorizes managed administrative closeout only.
